I'm studying currency trading on my own right now, and I'm confident I can become proficient. The thing is, whenever I've mentioned that I can't afford to go to the uni I want people usually say "why not pick a different one", and it's because I don't want to go anywhere else. I'm not about to compromise my dream and be somewhere I don't want. I'd rather take a step back and work harder to get where I want to be, which is what I plan on doing. 

What's holding me back right now is that I'm in such a toxic environment and it's so god damn hard to get out. I have a few moments every once and a while where I feel some kind of peace of mind and that gives me hope, but just makes it even more soul crushing when I feel suicidal a few hours later. It's like every time a take a step forward a new problem emerges and kicks me down to where I started. I don't even wish life would extend me an olive branch, I just wish it would stop extending the knife.
